tools.name: remote_list_computers
tools.description: List other PCs signed into the current Remote AI account, including platform, online status, and whether the Remote Command plugin is enabled. Use this before choosing a target.

tools.name: remote_execute
tools.description: Run a noninteractive command on a user-selected online PC with the Remote Command plugin installed and enabled. Returns stdout, stderr, exitCode, timedOut, truncated, and durationMs. Runs as the logged-in desktop user. Default to read-only diagnosis; changes require user authorization. Shell state is not retained. Never automatically retry after connection errors.

cwd.description: Absolute directory on the target PC. Defaults to that user's home.
